description: Human-scored scenarios for bounded multi-source research, provenance, and fallback behavior.

scenarios.prompt: Use b-research to compare current framework API behavior. Use Context7 first, then bounded primary-source discovery and independent corroboration. Choose top-level mcp for one operation and mcpScript only for two or more related operations, with no more than three sources/routes and five results per source.
must: Use Context7 first for versioned framework facts
Choose mcp for one operation and mcpScript for bounded multi-call work
Keep any mcpScript fan-out read-only and explicitly bounded
Use independent corroboration when needed
avoid: Using mcpScript for a single MCP operation
Private or local material sent to external tools

scenarios.prompt: Use b-research with mocked mcpScript results: one call returns {ok:true,data:{content:[text and resource blocks]}} with duplicate URLs, and another returns {ok:false,error:{code,message}}. Explain how you preserve provenance, normalize only title/url/claim/error, deduplicate by URL then title+claim, and report bounded partial results without claiming complete coverage.
must: Handle both {ok:true,data} and {ok:false,error} without treating failure as a successful source
Handle content-block envelopes without exposing or relying on unknown or binary fields
Normalize only title, URL, claim, and error
Deduplicate by URL then title+claim
Make partial failure explicit and bounded
avoid: Claiming complete coverage after a failed call
Adding an unbounded result parser or output

scenarios.prompt: Use b-research for a public API question. The mcp-scripting skill may be unavailable. Describe the fallback to direct mcp calls, then give bounded patterns for Context7 resolve-library-id to query-docs, Firecrawl plus Brave corroboration, and Firecrawl search selecting exactly one primary URL for one scrape.
must: Use direct top-level mcp calls when the manual mcp-scripting skill is unavailable and state the fallback
Resolve a Context7 library ID before querying its docs
Bound Firecrawl and Brave corroboration and deduplicate the results
Select one primary Firecrawl URL and scrape it at most once
avoid: Batching browser mutations or unsafe nested calls
Using fallback language to hide an unavailable source

scenarios.prompt: Use b-research to synthesize evidence from several public sources. Preserve each URL and relevant version, deduplicate sources, and label direct evidence, corroboration, and unresolved uncertainty.
must: Preserve URL and version provenance
Deduplicate sources
Distinguish direct evidence, corroboration, and uncertainty
avoid: Presenting unqualified claims without source provenance

scenarios.prompt: Use b-research for a library question when Context7 is unavailable. Continue with approved Firecrawl or Brave sources, keep the search bounded, and state the resulting coverage gap.
must: Use an approved fallback source
Keep fallback research bounded
State the coverage gap caused by the unavailable server
avoid: Pretending the unavailable source was consulted
Sending private repository material to public search

scenarios.prompt: Continue a compatible b-researcher session with a prior evidence packet containing source URLs, versions, as-of times, limitations, and a delta question. Reuse applicable evidence without repeating work, refresh a version-sensitive API claim, and report any remaining freshness gap.
must: Use the supplied continuation packet
Reuse only applicable evidence
Refresh the version-sensitive claim
Report unresolved freshness gaps
avoid: Treat continuation context as current truth
Send private or local material to external tools
Claim complete coverage without refreshed evidence
